properties.name: contexa.security.zerotrust.normalize-user-keys
properties.description: Whether every spelling of a name (capitals, full-width letters, surrounding spaces) reads one decision, so that a BLOCK of plain-k9 also stops PLAIN-K9. Turn it off when names of the application differ by case alone.

properties.name: contexa.security.zerotrust.analysis.new-context-limit.decisions
properties.description: How many decisions of a new context one person may ask the model for within the window, counted on each server: sign-ins and calls from another session, address or browser than the person's decision on record, together. Past it the model is not asked: such a call is refused with a CHALLENGE for itself alone (nothing is stored, the calls of the context on record go on), and a sign-in goes on undecided while the person's next request is asked to verify. Reaching it is logged and audited once a minute. A sign-in and its first call take two; moving between two devices takes one at each move. 0 or less sets no limit.

properties.name: contexa.security.zerotrust.analysis.new-context-limit.window
properties.description: The sliding window the decisions of a new context are counted in. A time that is not positive reads as one minute.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.capture-enabled
properties.description: Whether the OSS decision pipeline seals the final LLM prompt and the enforced decision into sealed evidence packages. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.snapshot-ttl
properties.description: Maximum time a captured prompt trace waits in memory for the decision pipeline to seal it.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.max-pending-snapshots
properties.description: Upper bound of prompt traces kept in memory before Layer1 completion; the oldest are evicted first.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.max-completed-snapshots
properties.description: Upper bound of completed prompt traces kept in memory until they are sealed; the oldest are evicted first.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.retention.enabled
properties.description: Whether expired sealed evidence packages are deleted on schedule. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.sample-percent
properties.description: Share of requests (1 to 100) whose decision is sealed, chosen by a stable hash of the request id, outside the full-capture window. It applies to the allowed decisions without a sign of risk, and to every decision once daily-limit is reached. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.daily-limit
properties.description: Sealed evidence packages of one UTC day up to which every decision that stopped the request (CHALLENGE, ESCALATE, BLOCK) and every allowed decision with a sign of risk is sealed: the most likely explanation is not legitimate work, the second analysis decided, the model was asked again, at least unknown-fact-threshold decision facts were unknown, or the personal baseline is not established. Every package of the day counts, as the store holds them, so the servers that share a database stay near one limit (each reads the count every 30 seconds and may pass the limit by what is sealed in between). Past the limit the day seals by full-capture-after-change and sample-percent alone, which the limit never holds back; the decisions left out are counted in the log. 0 seals by the window and the share alone. A sealed package takes about 60 KB of storage (measured on the sample decisions of the product), so the default adds at most about 120 MB a day. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.unknown-fact-threshold
properties.description: Unknown decision facts (facts the prompt lists as not integrated or not available) from which an allowed decision is sealed within daily-limit; at least 1. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.full-capture-after-change
properties.description: Decisions sealed in full after the node starts (a new inspector or dictionary version comes with a new build) and after the prompt version decisions run changes (the label moved, a rollback, the setting); a version a canary or a shadow runs beside it has a window of its own. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.retention.period
properties.description: How long a sealed evidence package is kept, whatever a prompt inspection found in it; the package's expiry is its capture time plus this period. A package that a prompt version trial decided again, or whose decision an administrator evaluated, is kept past its expiry for as long as that trial or evaluation is kept. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.retention.clean-period
properties.description: No package is removed by this period any more: every sealed evidence package is kept for retention.period. Earlier versions removed a package whose latest prompt inspection found nothing wrong once it was older than this period; the integrity check of sealed packages still reads a package missing before one older than the shorter of this period and retention.period as such a removal. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.retention.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron expression of the cleanup that deletes sealed evidence packages whose expiresAt has passed.
